trigger: A visible wrinkle/fold is claimed to result from skin slack, expression or local compression rather than texture, normal/bump, or a static art-directed displacement.

currentSubject.observedFact: Texture-free gray/clay on/off evidence and vertex deltas prove genuine geometry displacement on the tested subject.
currentSubject.unprovenClaim: No paired rest/compressed/stretched expression states bind the folds to measured local in-plane compression or prove deepen/narrow versus flatten/widen response and restoration.

requiredInputs: rest, compressed-expression and stretched-expression state digests
expression or deformation driver identity per region
local in-plane strain/compression measurement from the same carriers
fold height, trough depth, width and tangential shortening per state
gate: Texture, normal, bump or color-only differences cannot prove a geometric fold.
A static geometric fold proves geometry only; it cannot inherit the claim compression-driven.
The driver, local measured compression/stretch and responding fold region must be bound on the exact same subject.
Compression must deepen/narrow the applicable fold and stretch/tension must flatten/widen it within Mother-declared tolerances.
Unrelated regions must remain inside a declared negative-control bound.
Returning to rest must restore the baseline inside a declared error bound; otherwise HOLD.

activation.thresholds: UNKNOWN; Human Skin Mother must declare them before a production gate run.
activation.rollback: Delete or retire this Candidate if the trial adds no discrimination beyond the existing texture-free geometry proof or imposes an unworkable capture cost.
